[![](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.1016/j.cell.2023.05.004.svg)](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2023.05.004)

This repository is a fork of the repository published with ["Temperature-dependent RNA editing in octopus extensively recodes the neural proteome" by Birk et al](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0092867423005238?via%3Dihub). This fork contains a rewritten README and some additional minor modifications as part of a learning exercise for BIFX 572 at Hood College. Most figures in the paper can be reproduced here.

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(dplyr)

library(Biostrings)

library(ggplot2)
library(colorspace)
library(patchwork)

theme_set(theme_bw())

root <- here::here()
```

## Figures

Figure 1 displays subfigures illustrating the effect of exposure to cold temperatures on RNA editing activity in octopuses. Octopus drawings in panel A were reproduced, with permission, from Roger Hall and not included in this README.

```{r Fig1B}
#| fig-cap: "Figure 1B: A large proportion of the *O.bimaculoideseditome* exhibits increased editing at colder temperature (blue), but only 789 sites show a significant increase in warm samples (red)"

source(file.path(root, 'scripts', 'make_Fig1B.R'))

g1b
```

```{r Fig1C}
#| fig-cap: "Figure 1C: Cold-induced increases in editing levels were both more common and higher in magnitude than warm-induced increases."

source(file.path(root, 'scripts', 'make_Fig1C.R'))

g1c
```

Figure S1 also goes with these figures.

```{r FigS1}
source(file.path(root, 'scripts', 'make_figS1.R'))

ggsave(file.path(root, 'scripts', 'bigfigs', 'S1.png'),
       plot = (gs1[[1]] + gs1[[2]] + gs1[[3]]) /
              (gs1[[4]] + gs1[[5]] + gs1[[6]]) /
              (gs1[[7]] + gs1[[8]] + gs1[[9]]) /
              (gs1[[10]] + gs1[[11]] + gs1[[12]]),
       width = 9,
       height = 12,
       units = 'in')
```
